sources.title: From Montana to Albuquerque to the NFL: Keyshawn James-Newby Drafted by the Philadelphia Eagles
sources.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. – Every college football player hopes to hear their name on draft day. For former New Mexico edge rusher Keyshawn James-Newby, that hope turned into reality in the 2026 NFL Draft. The Philadelphia Eagles used their final pick, No. 252 overall, to select James-Newby.
